## Goal
- Execute owner's FINAL COMPLETION, DEPLOYMENT & VERIFICATION MANDATE (5 phases) to move IVX from "mostly complete" to "100% production verified" — finish SD-0001 capabilities, wire emergency-stop runtime, run full E2E QA, honest 50-agent factory audit, and return evidence-only final report; owner device sign-in remains NOT VERIFIED until owner's phone logs in successfully.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fake data ever; no VERIFIED/COMPLETE without live production evidence; allowed statuses: VERIFIED COMPLETE / PARTIALLY COMPLETE — EXACT ITEMS REMAINING / BLOCKED
- Owner sign-in gate: stays NOT VERIFIED until a successful password login from owner's device IP appears in production auth logs after 04:12Z repair
- Do not claim 50 verified agents unless all 50 completed real tasks; mark unexecuted agents NOT VERIFIED
- Blocked items requiring owner credentials (Google Play, Apple, EXPO_TOKEN) must be named explicitly with exact next step
- No secret values ever returned/stored; owner approval enforced at API boundaries

## Progress
### Done
- Owner sign-in forensics (JOB-0039, ledger id 0d0184bc-79e7-4a9e-a262-bd84dee19a76): device failure at 2026-07-18T04:07:41Z (12:07:41 AM EDT), POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password → HTTP 400 invalid_credentials, request_id 019f7368-93b9-77d6-a15c-8cba3e78fe4b, IP 172.58.131.184; root cause = stored password hash out of sync (global, not device); repaired 04:11:53Z; zero device retries since repair (only sandbox QA IPs 34.169.237.253 / 35.252.137.212)
- Forensics + APK link posted to owner chat (conversation 8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41, sender 9b280e15-...) — both HTTP 201
- APK delivered & verified live: https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/releases/ivx-holdings-v1.4.6-build38.apk — HTTP 200, 84,654,296 bytes, SHA-256 36ff2c638239812ad9331e77501e5e6b98c4c99b3a9aa468ffdf967768adb381 (re-downloaded & re-hashed, byte-identical to /tmp/apk.zip)
- Phase 1 SHA parity verified: GitHub main HEAD = Render deploy = /health commitSha f82e5a5d2f044e15209b1f8bdb8b0aab868b0440 (repo ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest, Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0, deploy dep-d9dec4v41pts73cv5vog LIVE); /health 200 healthy, seniorDeveloperRuntime enabled, all 4 credentials true
- Emergency-stop gate written: new backend/services/ivx-emergency-stop-gate.ts (checkEmergencyStop, assertEmergencyStopInactive, 15s cache, fails OPEN, reads ivx_agent_controls.emergency_stop via service role); wired into backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts at enqueue (enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob) and job-start (processNextSeniorDeveloperJob) boundaries
- SD-0001 branch+PR proof endpoint written: new backend/api/ivx-branch-pr-proof.ts (GET/POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/branch-pr-proof; real branch sd0001/branch-pr-proof-<ts> → commit proof file to logs/audit/sd-0001/ → open PR vs main → close unmerged); routes + import registered in backend/hono.ts (~line 750 import, after /run route ~line 3592)
- GitHub audit via production endpoint confirms canReadRepo, canPush, admin/maintain/push permissions all true
- Owner token valid (owner_at → /auth/v1/user 200); ivx_agent_controls.emergency_stop currently active=false
- Typecheck: `bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` → 130 pre-existing errors repo-wide, ZERO errors in the 3 new/edited files (grep for ivx-emergency-stop-gate|ivx-branch-pr-proof|services/ivx-senior-developer-worker returned none)

### In Progress
- Phase 1 completion: commit + push emergency-stop gate & branch-PR-proof to main, wait for Render deploy, verify new routes live, then POST branch-pr-proof to capture real PR number/URL as SD-0001 evidence
- Phase 3 E2E QA battery (15 modules: owner login, logout/login, session persistence, members, investors, buyers, deals, reels, chat, landing registration, notifications, admin dashboard, owner dashboard, API, database, prod health)
- Phase 4 honest factory agent audit; Phase 5 final evidence report

### Blocked
- Owner-device sign-in verification: awaiting owner to attempt login on phone (server-side auth confirmed working; no device attempt since 04:12Z repair)
- EAS cloud builds / Google Play AAB submission / iOS TestFlight: EXPO_TOKEN and Apple credentials absent (APR-003); local Gradle builds proven (APK 36ff2c63, AAB 89840a62)
- Shell env vars RENDER_API_KEY/RENDER_SERVICE_ID/GITHUB_TOKEN/GITHUB_REPO_URL are EMPTY locally (len=0) — direct Render/GitHub API calls from shell fail; must use production owner-only endpoints (github-audit works) or find tokens elsewhere for git push

## Key Decisions
- Emergency-stop gate fails OPEN on Supabase read errors (logged) so transient outages don't freeze production work; enforcement at enqueue + job-start boundaries
- Branch+PR proof closes PR unmerged so main stays clean while PR remains permanent auditable evidence
- Report agent inventory honestly: only SD-0001 (partial), RM-0001, PIA-0001 genuinely operational; AF-001..012 and FA-01..FA-50 are SPEC-ONLY/UNTESTED — never claim 50 verified
- Backend password sign-in goes direct to Supabase Auth (never api.ivxholding.com), so Supabase auth service logs ARE the backend logs for login requests

## Next Steps
1. Resolve git push path (local env tokens empty) — options: use production /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker or /run endpoints with owner_at to commit+deploy the new files, or locate tokens
2. Deploy emergency-stop gate + branch-pr-proof; verify /health new bootTime + routes respond
3. Execute POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/branch-pr-proof with owner token; record PR number/URL in ledger
4. Optionally toggle emergency_stop true→verify enqueue refusal→false as live enforcement proof
5. Run Phase 3 E2E QA against production endpoints (leads/capture, owner-dashboard, member-admin/dashboard, control-room/status, etc.), Supabase data counts (members 4, investors 875, buyers 0, deals 3, reels 5)
6. Phase 4 agent audit (ivx_ia_tasks queue state: 13 QUEUED, 5 RUNNING, 9 DONE, 4 VERIFIED, 2 OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED, 1 BLOCKED)
7. Compile Phase 5 evidence report → ivx_agent_jobs ledger + owner chat; keep sign-in NOT VERIFIED pending owner device login
